newsitem.title: USA: ILX to buy Debbie Reynolds hotel.
newsitem.headline: ILX to buy Debbie Reynolds hotel.

text.p: ILX Inc said on Thursday it had entered into a definitive agreement to buy the Debbie Reynolds Hotel and Casino in Las Vegas for a total of $16.8 million.
The purchase price includes 3,750,000 ILX common shares, valued for purposes of the transaction at $2 each, and $4.2 million in cash and $5.1 million in assumption of mortgage debt.
The transaction, which is subject to shareholder approval, is expected to close in the first quarter of 1997, ILX said.
The Debbie Reynolds Hotel consists of 193 rooms spread over a six-acre property located half a block from the Las Vegas "strip" and from the city convention center.
